ad_creatives_destination_valid.name: ad_creatives_destination_valid
ad_creatives_destination_valid.value:
COALESCE(CASE "ad_creatives"."destination_type"
        WHEN 'URL' THEN "ad_creatives"."destination_url" ~ '^https://[^[:space:]]+$'
          AND "ad_creatives"."whatsapp_phone" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."whatsapp_message" IS NULL
          AND "ad_creatives"."destination_space_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'WHATSAPP' THEN "ad_creatives"."whatsapp_phone" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
          AND char_length("ad_creatives"."whatsapp_message") BETWEEN 1 AND 500
          AND "ad_creatives"."destination_url" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."destination_space_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'SPACE' THEN "ad_creatives"."destination_space_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ad_creatives"."destination_url" IS NULL AND "ad_creatives"."whatsapp_phone" IS NULL
          AND "ad_creatives"."whatsapp_message" IS NULL
      END, false)

ad_creatives_text_length.name: ad_creatives_text_length
ad_creatives_text_length.value:
char_length("ad_creatives"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 40
        AND ("ad_creatives"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("ad_creatives"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 90)
        AND char_length("ad_creatives"."cta_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 20

subscriptions_period_valid.name: subscriptions_period_valid
subscriptions_period_valid.value: "subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."current_period_end" >= "subscriptions"."current_period_start"

teacher_occupations_period_valid.name: teacher_occupations_period_valid
teacher_occupations_period_valid.value: NOT isempty("teacher_occupations"."period") AND NOT lower_inf("teacher_occupations"."period") AND NOT upper_inf("teacher_occupations"."period") AND lower_inc("teacher_occupations"."period") AND NOT upper_inc("teacher_occupations"."period")

contact_touchpoints_email_or_phone.name: contact_touchpoints_email_or_phone
contact_touchpoints_email_or_phone.value: "contact_touchpoints"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "contact_touchpoints"."phone" IS NOT NULL

contacts_email_or_phone.name: contacts_email_or_phone
contacts_email_or_phone.value: "contacts"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL

users_email_or_phone.name: users_email_or_phone
users_email_or_phone.value: "users"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

online_charges_amounts_valid.name: online_charges_amounts_valid
online_charges_amounts_valid.value: "online_charges"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "online_charges"."service_amount_cents" > 0 AND "online_charges"."platform_fee_cents" >= 0 AND "online_charges"."platform_fee_cents" <= "online_charges"."amount_cents" AND "online_charges"."gateway_cost_cents" >= 0 AND "online_charges"."space_net_cents" >= 0 AND "online_charges"."fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "online_charges"."min_fee_cents" >= 0

online_charges_split_consistent.name: online_charges_split_consistent
online_charges_split_consistent.value: CASE "online_charges"."fee_payer" WHEN 'SPACE' THEN "online_charges"."amount_cents" = "online_charges"."service_amount_cents" AND "online_charges"."space_net_cents" = "online_charges"."amount_cents" - "online_charges"."platform_fee_cents" ELSE "online_charges"."amount_cents" = "online_charges"."service_amount_cents" + "online_charges"."platform_fee_cents" AND "online_charges"."space_net_cents" = "online_charges"."service_amount_cents" END

platform_fee_settings_values.name: platform_fee_settings_values
platform_fee_settings_values.value: "platform_fee_settings"."pix_fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "platform_fee_settings"."card_fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "platform_fee_settings"."min_fee_cents" >= 0

space_ledger_entries_charge_kind_unique.name: space_ledger_entries_charge_kind_unique
space_ledger_entries_charge_kind_unique.where: "space_ledger_entries"."refund_id" IS NULL AND "space_ledger_entries"."payout_id" IS NULL AND "space_ledger_entries"."charge_id" IS NOT NULL

space_ledger_entries_sign.name: space_ledger_entries_sign
space_ledger_entries_sign.value: CASE "space_ledger_entries"."kind" WHEN 'SALE' THEN "space_ledger_entries"."amount_cents" > 0 WHEN 'FEE_REFUND' THEN "space_ledger_entries"."amount_cents" > 0 WHEN 'ADJUSTMENT' THEN "space_ledger_entries"."amount_cents" <> 0 ELSE "space_ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0 END

space_payment_settings_fee_values.name: space_payment_settings_fee_values
space_payment_settings_fee_values.value: ("space_payment_settings"."pix_fee_bps" IS NULL OR "space_payment_settings"."pix_fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000) AND ("space_payment_settings"."card_fee_bps" IS NULL OR "space_payment_settings"."card_fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000) AND ("space_payment_settings"."min_fee_cents" IS NULL OR "space_payment_settings"."min_fee_cents" >= 0)

payment_records_reversal_consistent.name: payment_records_reversal_consistent
payment_records_reversal_consistent.value: "payment_records"."reversed_by" IS NULL OR "payment_records"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL

payment_records_channel_consistent.name: payment_records_channel_consistent
payment_records_channel_consistent.value: CASE "payment_records"."channel" WHEN 'ON_SITE' THEN "payment_records"."recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_records"."online_charge_id" IS NULL ELSE "payment_records"."online_charge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_records"."recorded_by" IS NULL END

bookings_organizer_or_guest.name: bookings_organizer_or_guest
bookings_organizer_or_guest.value: "bookings"."organizer_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bookings"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL

recurring_bookings_user_or_guest.name: recurring_bookings_user_or_guest
recurring_bookings_user_or_guest.value: "recurring_bookings"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_bookings"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL

court_blocks_period_valid.name: court_blocks_period_valid
court_blocks_period_valid.value: NOT isempty("court_blocks"."period") AND NOT lower_inf("court_blocks"."period") AND NOT upper_inf("court_blocks"."period")

court_occupations_period_valid.name: court_occupations_period_valid
court_occupations_period_valid.value: NOT isempty("court_occupations"."period") AND NOT lower_inf("court_occupations"."period") AND NOT upper_inf("court_occupations"."period") AND lower_inc("court_occupations"."period") AND NOT upper_inc("court_occupations"."period")
